Tools.description:
The commit's executables, each present when its crate exists in the
workspace. Tests of a Product's executable crate use its
`CARGO_BIN_EXE_` path instead.

description: One test's setup, as the TypeScript and Python packages read it.

env.description: The cleared environment of every child the test starts.

folder.description:
The test's own folder, whose name holds a space and a non-ASCII
letter; removed when the test ends.

home.description: `<folder>/home`, the `GOODFETCH_HOME` of everything the test starts.

seed.description: The test's seed, at most 2^53 - 1 so every language reads it exactly.

start_time.description: The test's start time, RFC 3339 in UTC.

tools.description: The commit's executables, from the test tool manifest.

title: Description
